# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Hi, yeah, I need some help with an order. I ended up with two tablets and I only need one, so I want to return the more expensive one and get that refund put back on my credit card.

My name is Chen Silva, zip code 46281.

I do *not* remember what email I used, sorry, I’ve got a few and I never keep track of which one I use for what. If you can look it up another way, that’d be great.
chen_silva_7485

To return the more expensive tablet and refund it to your credit card, I need the specific order and item. Your orders are:
- #W3069600
- #W2598834
- #W8171054
- #W9571698

Please tell me which order has the two tablets, and if you know it, which tablet/item is the more expensive one. If you’re not sure, I can help identify it.

Oh perfect, thank you.

I’m not sure which order it is, honestly. It’s the one with the two tablets on it — can you check which of those orders has two tablets? That’d probably be fastest.

And no, I don’t know the item name off the top of my head either, just that one was definitely more expensive than the other, and that’s the one I want to send back. Refund to the credit card, please.
